content.text: Fixed. The single-pass `<[^>]+>` replace is what CodeQL flags — a nested/overlapping construction like `<<script>` can leave a live `<script>` tag after just one pass, since JS `replace(/…/g, …)` matches non-overlapping occurrences in one left-to-right scan rather than re-scanning the result. `stripHtml` now loops the tag-stripping regex until a pass removes nothing, so no residual tag can survive.
No errors. Since output also passes through `escapeXml` before being embedded in the SVG, this closes the CodeQL finding with defense in depth on both the sanitizer and the sink.

All 21 tests pass. Summary of the fix in [inputs.css](renderers/pendo/src/css/inputs.css#L491-L610):

- Added an on-color (elevated alert) override block scoped to `[class*="instui-alert"][data-layout="lightboxBlank"]`:
  - Radio group labels (multi-choice/PMF) now use `--instui-component-text-base-on-color`.
  - Number-scale/NPS description labels ("Horrible"/"Great") now use `--instui-component-text-muted-on-color`.
  - Number-scale/NPS/UX-Lite scale buttons: unselected state uses the same inverse-ghost tokens as `._pendo-button-secondaryButton` in alerts (transparent background, on-color border/text), selected (`:checked`) state uses the inverse primary-button tokens (solid on-color background/border/text).
  - Added a `&[class*="-warning"]` sub-override reverting all of the above back to the standard (non-on-color) tokens, matching the existing convention in `button.css` where warning alerts keep standard action colors instead of inverse ones.

Rebuilt `dist/`/`generated/` outputs and ran the package's test suite — all 21 tests pass.
